mapper.scope: Use concept/family/neighborhood/normalization/membership data. The mapper JSON's legacy scoring_boundary placeholder is not the current scoring contract.

canonical.description: Sparse exact canonical musical concepts resolved from immutable Gemini labels.
canonical.duplicate_policy: aliases and duplicate resolution routes never add duplicate mass
canonical.minimum_evidence_gate: both tracks require at least one usable specific style-like concept; broad-family-only profiles are a no-op

role: residual bridge between different but related canonical concepts
neighborhood.description: Overlapping lower-dimensional style-neighborhood profile derived from canonical concepts. It supplements but does not replace exact concept identity.

canonical.name: weighted_jaccard_canonical
canonical.formula: sum_k min(c_k(a), c_k(b)) / sum_k max(c_k(a), c_k(b))

residual_neighborhood.projection: project only unmatched eligible style-like concepts through concept-to-neighborhood membership; broad family concepts do not create residual neighborhood support by themselves
residual_neighborhood.name: weighted_jaccard_residual_neighborhood
residual_neighborhood.formula: sum_n min(n_r(a), n_r(b)) / sum_n max(n_r(a), n_r(b))

full_neighborhood_diagnostic.name: weighted_jaccard_full_neighborhood
full_neighborhood_diagnostic.role: diagnostic only; retained to compare against the earlier neighborhood-first proposal

canonical_plus_residual.description: Preferred current development candidate. Exact concept agreement is primary; neighborhoods only fill part of the unmatched headroom.

neighborhood_only_diagnostic.description: Earlier neighborhood-first style comparison retained for side-by-side diagnosis, not preferred by default.

eta.meaning: maximum fraction of remaining genre-similarity headroom that residual neighborhood relationships may fill
eta.policy: visible/configurable but fixed during a review session; do not auto-tune from the 16-song manual review

audio_baseline.policy: take as-is; do not retrain, reweight, normalize, or multiply it by genre during this experiment

pull_only.description: shared canonical/related genre evidence can attract; lack of relationship does not repel

signed_experimental.gate: both tracks must have usable specific genre evidence; otherwise G_force = 0
signed_experimental.description: development low-overlap penalty ablation only; a negative value is not proof of genre incompatibility

alpha.meaning: fraction of the permitted genre force; zero is the exact original audio baseline

beta.meaning: maximum absolute genre contribution in score units for the first development explorer
beta.policy: visible/configurable but fixed during a review session; do not auto-tune from the 16-song manual review

retrieval.policy: neighborhood retrieval changes candidate availability only; retrieval score does not automatically become final pair score

move_graph.off: keep frozen coordinates; update scores/ranks/diagnostics only
move_graph.on: derive temporary layout from adjusted edge weights
move_graph.interpretation: physical graph distance is approximate; pair scores and ranks are authoritative

sequence: manual owner review on original 16 frozen Gemini profiles
compare canonical-only, canonical-plus-residual, and neighborhood-only diagnostic on the same 16
use pull-only as the default; retain signed mode only as a development ablation
only then run unchanged definitions on frozen 100
freeze any selected scoring rule before fresh confirmation
invariants: no song- or artist-specific mapper exceptions
canonical identity is never overwritten by neighborhood projection
scene/context/unresolved evidence is a sonic no-op by default
broad-family-only profiles are not a perfect pairwise match
neighborhood retrieval and pairwise scoring are separate responsibilities
no automatic alpha/beta/eta selection from the 16-song review
